Homelessness is at a crisis level in our community. We have to:

→ Get housing costs down
→ Expand access to mental health services 
→ Increase emergency services like short term housing and addiction treatment to break the cycle

I went to sleep last night furious. I was 14 when Columbine happened, now I’m 35 with a baby daughter. Nothing has changed in 20 years to stop this madness.

There are 50 Republican Senators who refuse to vote for commonsense gun reform. They need to hear from us every single day

Good news for families like mine that are on baby formula waitlists – now let’s get this formula on shelves! 

https://t.co/YLXiIxtq2g

🚨 Medicare Open Enrollment is going on now! 🚨

Deadline to apply is March 31st.

https://t.co/okGXDcrBml... https://t.co/7L6F4ftvSR

Every week, for my entire life, my dad has seen patients who have gone blind because they couldn’t afford their insulin.
 
It’s that common and that expensive. We need to cap the price of insulin for EVERYONE. https://t.co/yavMXCP6Mj

choices.label: Neither, keep it as it is

items.text:
Getting really tired of losing sleep and switching our clocks twice a year.

Most people want to pick either Standard or Daylight Savings time and keep it that way. No more back and forth.

Which time should we make permanent?

Anyone else getting destroyed by allergies this year?

I’ve tried every treatment under the sun and I still can’t breathe. 🤧

ICYMI, the $35/month cap on insulin for Medicare patients has officially gone into effect.

No one should have to choose between their groceries and the medication they need. This will save lives.

Next step: capping insulin costs for EVERYONE. https://t.co/CzURUBN1yI

🥵 As the heat goes over 100 again, watch for symptoms of heat-related illnesses.

Signs of heat exhaustion: dizziness, extreme thirst, heavy sweating, nausea, weakness

Signs of heat stroke: confusion, dizziness, loss of consciousness (CALL 911!)

https://t.co/YRgoxFg0E5

There’s a serious lack of healthcare workers in San Joaquin County.
 
Proud to bring home $3.8 Million for @SJDeltaCollege nursing program to double the number of nurses trained each year. https://t.co/NQSomO8jKs

We are the breadbasket of the world – 25% of our country’s food is grown right here. 
 
Our farmworkers deserve the respect and the healthcare they need to keep themselves and our country healthy. https://t.co/QUPicWY5F2

NATIONAL: Our fight to get San Joaquin veterans better care has officially gone national. 

We won't stop until our heroes get the healthcare they’ve earned. https://t.co/ERBcY2zh47

🚨 Cyberattacks on hospitals have increased by more than 400% this year.
 
The FBI and other law enforcement work hard to stop hackers, but this issue isn’t going away.

Our hospitals need more cybersecurity resources to keep patients safe and protect our families’ private data. https://t.co/D589HkuDUY

Open enrollment for Medicare and Medicaid is going on through December 7th.
 
This is the time of year to visit https://t.co/Oxk4WpVH1m and sign up for a healthcare plan as low as $10/ month. https://t.co/jGWsBoRBVe

GREAT NEWS: Stockton is getting $1,000,000 to support opioid addiction treatment and recovery
 
A huge step in the right direction.
 
https://t.co/3AzGSGthuX

San Joaquin County veterans should never have to worry about where they’re going to sleep at night.
 
Those who fought for us overseas shouldn’t be fighting to survive here at home. They deserve so much better. https://t.co/BA0Zx98qYB

Scary stuff. Criminals are stealing our private health data – we have to get hospitals the resources they need to keep our data safe.  

https://t.co/1v95aexpke

He was in so much pain he couldn’t work and was told it would be MONTHS before he could get a MRI to find out what was causing the pain.

Our office pushed the VA and we got him the MRI and treatment he needed.
(2/5)

Grateful my office was able to get an expedited visa for Alejandro so he could reunite with his mother after her scary diagnosis.

If you or a loved one need help with visas, please call my office at 209-579-5458. https://t.co/AqEibA8y42

It’s already expensive enough to raise a family. Getting and keeping affordable home insurance shouldn’t be this hard.

We can’t let families get priced out of our own communities.
https://t.co/CSB6cZ87Uh

One of the most important parts of my job is helping families navigate issues with federal agencies. From delayed visas and passports to issues with Medicare and VA benefits, we’re here to help!

You can call our Stockton office at (209) 579-5458 or visit https://t.co/yn2m6uxzPH.

Happy to share the Stockton VA has now hired enough doctors to be fully staffed and appointment wait times are down. Still more work to do, but an important step to making sure our veterans get the healthcare they've earned 

https://t.co/W7yOQZ03dA

On Necrotizing Fasciitis Awareness Day, I want to shout out our local hero Pfc. Dez Del Barba who is using his diagnosis to push for more medical coverage for our soldiers. Proud to be in this fight with you.

https://t.co/wdAvP5tNHv

NEWS: Medicare cut prices for 10 life-saving prescription drugs. 1st major step since we capped insulin at $35. Really important moves here but we need to keep pushing.

https://t.co/VxGYWpjsge

I’ve been in contact with the FDA and I’m closely monitoring the situation to make sure our hospitals have the IV fluids needed to care for patients.
 My thoughts are with everyone who has been affected by Hurricane Helene. https://t.co/gj8MDwO8Pv
